result.stdout:
Usage:
  sigillon render <input.docx> [output.pdf] [font options]
  sigillon render --batch <listfile> --out-dir <dir> [font options]

The "render" verb is optional; the bare forms without it are still accepted:
  sigillon <input.docx> [output.pdf] [font options]
  sigillon --batch <listfile> --out-dir <dir> [font options]

Font options:
  --font-dir <dir>      Add a recursively searched TTF/OTF/TTC directory (repeatable)
  --no-system-fonts     Use only configured font directories for deterministic output
  --portable-metafiles  Use the cross-platform WMF decoder on every operating system
  --text-engine <name>  Text layout engine: harfbuzz
  --pdf-backend <name>  PDF painter: skia
  --layout-trace <path> Write backend-neutral layout diagnostics as JSONL
  --font-report <path>  Write the fonts each render resolved as JSON; in batch mode,
                        one JSON line per list entry keyed by line index and SHA-256
  --strict-fonts        Refuse a document whose fonts would be substituted; no PDF
                        is written, and --font-report still names what was refused
